title: The stronger bear the weak’s sins
english: On the word [[You and your sons and your father’s house with you shall bear the sins of the sanctuary >> Bible:Numbers 18:1]]: the better always take up the faults of those below. The Apostle says, [[You who are stronger, bear the weaknesses of the weak >> Bible:Romans 15:1]]. A lay Israelite who sins needs Levite, priest, even high priest; a priest who fails can cleanse his own — unless he sins against God.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
After Homilia IX; sanctuary sins CLOSEOUT.

title: Natural law written on the heart
english: The natural law God wrote with his finger on hearts gives seeds of truth; if we cultivate them well, they bear fruit of life in Christ Jesus, to whom be glory forever. Amen.
